actual_views.method: Same fixed-threshold RGB raster displayed from memory before write; alpha>=128 black, lower alpha white

observations: Raw source includes glow. The actual alpha128 silhouette is clearly legible; fixed threshold discards subthreshold glow and some antialiased edges.
Whole-phrase placement is uniform and retains all source paths. The upper 一 stroke stays visibly above the right cup rim; actual cup contact was not achieved.
The lower row visibly overlays the tray upper edge, dried tea and part of the fresh leaf. No leaf mask or photo foreground raster was added; no leaf-before-letter depth effect is claimed.

The new glyphs have broad rounded brush forms and a tight row gap. Their stroke weight remains stronger than the slender reference, and bright stream highlights weaken contrast behind parts of the upper 茶.
慢 keeps readable 日/罒 and lower 又; 杯 retains 木/不; 下 and 来 remain complete. Original brand glyphs are unchanged.
